class.name: VirtualGeometryMesh
class.brief_description: A virtual geometry model root and its material bindings.
class.description: Stores validated VGMR root metadata and a relative page-container filename. Detailed pages are not loaded or expanded by this resource. The standard Mesh array API cannot expand its geometry; collision and navigation use separately prepared resources. On Forward+, requesting a rendering RID registers the typed root and queues its mandatory pages. Detailed pages follow bounded GPU demand. [method prepare_virtual_geometry] can delay scene publication until the complete root set has reached the GPU. Unsupported renderer capabilities fail explicitly. The Cooker/headless Dummy stores typed metadata without GPU readiness.

method.name: get_streaming_error
method.description: Returns the root preparation error, or [constant OK] while its owner remains valid. Query [method is_render_ready] separately for completion.

method.name: is_render_ready
method.description: Returns whether all mandatory root pages have completed GPU publication. Dummy metadata preparation does not return GPU readiness.

method.name: prepare_virtual_geometry
method.description: Starts typed installation on the main thread. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] while admission or root publication is pending, [constant OK] when prepared, and another error on failure. Dummy preparation is data-only.

method.name: get_geometry_data
method.description: Returns root bytes, the page-container filename and byte count, and material bindings. Changing the returned dictionary or byte array does not replace this resource's metadata. Material resources themselves remain shared.

method.name: has_geometry
method.description: Returns whether root metadata and bindings have been configured. This does not indicate that page bytes exist or that GPU rendering is ready.

method.name: set_geometry_data
method.description: Accepts exactly four fields: [code]root[/code] (VGMR PackedByteArray), [code]container[/code] (a local lowercase filename ending in [code].vgp[/code]), [code]container_bytes[/code] (positive integer), and [code]materials[/code] (one Material or null per dense root slot). Root bytes are limited to 64 MiB and decoded metadata to 256 MiB. Configuration checks metadata without reading the container or hashing files. Failure preserves the entire previous configuration. A root with a rendering identity is immutable; prepare a new resource for transactional replacement. Call on the main thread.
